name: MMBench-CN
intro: MMBench-CN 在此限定为 2023 年 10 月中文 v1.0 发布，而不是 3,217 题的 CN v1.1。它由英文 v1.0 经 GPT-4 翻译与人工核验形成，图像、原题 ID、类别、划分及答案逐项对齐，共有 DEV 1,164 + TEST 1,784 = 2,948 道逻辑题。
org: Shanghai AI Laboratory, Nanyang Technological University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, National University of Singapore, Zhejiang University
build_method: 英文 v1.0 构建与双路质控、GPT-4 翻译问题和选项、保留专名/符号/代码、人工核验有效性与正确性
metric: CircularEval 逻辑题准确率（总体微平均、L2/L3 分组）
eval_feature: 中英逐题对齐, CircularEval, 中文启发式与 GPT-4-0125 选项抽取
build_method_en: English v1.0 construction and dual quality control, GPT-4 translation of questions and choices while preserving names/symbols/code, and human validity/correctness verification
eval_feature_en: Item-aligned Chinese release, CircularEval, Chinese heuristic and GPT-4-0125 choice extraction
intro_en: MMBench-CN is bounded here to the October-2023 Chinese v1.0 release, not the 3,217-item CN v1.1 dataset. It was produced from English v1.0 through GPT-4 translation and human verification; images, base IDs, categories, splits, and answers align item by item. DEV 1,164 + TEST 1,784 yields 2,948 logical questions.
scale_en: v1.0 has 2,948 logical items; DEV 1,164 / TEST 1,784
metric_en: CircularEval logical-item accuracy (overall micro-average and L2/L3 groups)

drawio_review_note: This identity is the verified Chinese v1.0 mate of the October-2023 English release, not CN v1.1. The audit pins arXiv:2307.06281v5 and MMBench repository commit 8eaac9ae42e22eaf42863b218455acd51268ba1c. The official files contain 1,164 DEV and 1,784 TEST logical items (2,948 total); current VLMEvalKit pins MD5 08b8fc3324a5ed74155350f57be69fbd and 7e1239baf0ee4c8b513e19705a0f317e. Direct TSV comparison confirms that EN/CN v1.0 share every row index, image, category, L2 category, split, and available answer; circular rows share a base ID. The paper says GPT-4 translates questions and choices while proper nouns, symbols, and code remain unchanged, followed by human validity and correctness checks. DEV labels are public, TEST labels are hidden and evaluated by official submission. Evaluation uses a Chinese zero-shot image/optional-hint/question/choices prompt, heuristic choice extraction, gpt-4-0125 fallback, and CircularEval: all N option rotations must be correct for one logical-item hit. The current report code computes a micro mean over logical-item hits overall and within L2/L3. Released judge code can retry three times and then return a random valid choice or Z. Openness is partly public because TEST labels remain hidden, scoring uses an official service, image provenance is mixed, and the repository Apache-2.0 license does not itself relicense dataset images. Formal publication evidence [site-a11m-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 3845×785 (English) and 3845×785 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 3843×783 and 3843×783. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
